## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON with Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; Financials and Industrials showing clear strength while Technology and Utilities contribute meaningful upside. Confirmations: (1) Financials + Industrials are ABOVE TREND with leading names (JPM, COF, CAT); (2) both cyclicals and growth (semiconductors) exhibiting positive momentum — style mixed but tilting cyclical/value; note a major divergence among large-cap techs that tempers conviction.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Financials lead: JPM (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +10.71% | 1M: +10.71%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: CAT (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +14.61%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +0.49% | 1M: +3.59%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities buoyant: VST (1W: +11.87% | 1M: +21.56%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +11.09% | 1M: +5.14%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy weak: XOM (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -15.22%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -6.56% | 1M: -11.97%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare under pressure: JNJ (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -0.13%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -5.37% | 1M: +7.55%) CORRECTION. Communication lag: CHTR (1W: -9.28% | 1M: -11.42%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: +12.83% | 1M: +0.48%) ABOVE TREND showing intra-sector dispersion.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, TTWO (1W: +12.83% | 1M: +0.48%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +11.87% | 1M: +21.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +51.85%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +11.41% | 1M: +16.02%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Moderate concentration (3/5 Technology); style: mixed with a tilt toward cyclical/value given Financials/Industrials strength.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ACN (1W: -23.60% | 1M: -27.61%) BELOW TREND, SLB (1W: -14.12% | 1M: -14.85%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -10.80% | 1M: -23.46%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -15.19%) BELOW TREND, CCI (1W: -9.81% | 1M: -10.11%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in large-cap software, energy and real estate.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, TTWO (1W: +12.83% | 1M: +0.48%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +51.85%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence: multiple mega-cap techs (AAPL, NVDA, GOOGL, META, AMZN) show RECOVERY patterns (1W up, 1M down) — a tactical divergence to watch for trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but constructive: Semiconductors lead (INTC (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +51.85%) ABOVE TREND), while large-cap software and services show strain (ACN (1W: -23.60% | 1M: -27.61%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -10.80% | 1M: -23.46%) BELOW TREND). Tech breadth is mixed within the sector and shows internal rotation between semis and software.

8. Financials Outlook?
Healthy and broad: JPM (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +10.71% | 1M: +10.71%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.57% | 1M: -0.81%) RECOVERY — sector momentum favors cyclical exposure and supports the RISK-ON backdrop.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Under pressure and defensive not leading: JNJ (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -0.13%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -0.57% | 1M: +3.60%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -5.37% | 1M: +7.55%) CORRECTION — breadth shows weakness despite some one-month strength.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Financials and select Industrials/semiconductors (JPM (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +14.61%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to lagging Energy and large-cap software names exhibiting clear BELOW TREND behavior (XOM, ACN). Style: mixed but tilting Value/Cyclical; monitor RECOVERY signals in mega-cap techs before reallocating to core growth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +51.85%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +10.71% | 1M: +10.71%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ACN (1W: -23.60% | 1M: -27.61%) BELOW TREND, SLB (1W: -14.12% | 1M: -14.85%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -15.22%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Financials (Breadth positive; leaders ABOVE TREND), Industrials (momentum across heavy equipment and aerospace), Utilities (strong short-term performance). BEARISH: Energy (deep weakness across names), Healthcare (mixed with CORRECTIONs), Communication (intra-sector dispersion).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch INTC to sustain 1W gains for continued ABOVE TREND momentum; monitor AMAT for follow-through above recent breakout to validate the semis advance; NVDA (1W: +2.84% | 1M: -4.39%) RECOVERY — needs weekly confirmation to shift growth leadership back; JPM (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%) sustaining 1M trend would reinforce cyclicals.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
INTC (+65): After-Chips US manufacturing headlines; price confirming as INTC (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment aligned with accumulation. TTWO (+65): GTA VI preorder news; TTWO (1W: +12.83% | 1M: +0.48%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming. JPM (+50): AI operational shift headline; JPM (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment supports financial leadership.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ACN (-50): Negative analyst headlines; ACN (1W: -23.60% | 1M: -27.61%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and material. WMT (-45): China food safety headline; WMT (1W: -2.76% | 1M: -12.68%) BELOW TREND — sentiment aligned with price weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, style mixed with a tilt to Value/Cyclical. JPM (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND and INTC (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND are showing leadership while ACN (1W: -23.60% | 1M: -27.61%) BELOW TREND and XOM (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -15.22%) BELOW TREND show clear weakness. Key risk: major-cap tech RECOVERY patterns (AAPL, NVDA, GOOGL, META, AMZN) create a divergence that warrants monitoring before broadening growth exposure.
